items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: Especially with that Jack Reed song, that Patrick.

ctx.x: Who's this band, the Sharky, the Chester? Yeah, but I mean did he play with Bersdorf too? No. That must have been before I came to town, Chief.

Oh yeah, yeah. What was his name? I can't think of it. Well anyway, from him we turned to Shaline. Then I doubled up on tuba and string bass. Freddie Newman was playing piano. Joe Caparro was playing guitar. Now, they gave me the business of being the man to run the band. They were the leader because I told them I didn't want anything about leadership. And up until today I don't. But I told them just what I would like for them to do and play. And I told the drummer, I says, fan brushes at all times. I says, and…
Bands today? No, no, they didn't sound like the bands today because mostly of them, to tell you the truth, they were not accomplished musicians.
